en.answer:
No, you cannot.

The ①st effect of <<18315>> can only be resolved if <<18315>>, the Trap Card, is being activated.

Therefore, effects such as the ③rd effect of <<12026>>, which apply another card's effect as that effect, cannot apply to the ①st effect of <<18315>>.
